title: MSC World Asia Passenger Information — V1.1

sections.heading: Welcome aboard MSC World Asia
sections.body: Independent Elevor360D passenger guide for MSC World Asia guests. Not affiliated with MSC Cruises.

sections.heading: About MSC World Asia
sections.body: MSC World Asia is an MSC Cruises passenger ship. Check the official ship information for current facilities, dining, entertainment and accessibility.

sections.heading: Official ship information and deck plans
sections.body:
Official ship information: https://www.msccruises.co.uk/ships/msc-world-asia
Official deck plans PDF: https://www.msccruises.co.uk/content/dam/msc-cruises/b2c-assets/fleet/msc-world-asia/MSC_WORLD_ASIA_DECKPLAN.pdf
Internet connection required to open these links.

sections.heading: Finding your cabin
sections.body: Record your cabin, deck, muster point and nearby lifts. Verify all locations using official onboard information.

sections.heading: Dining, bars and entertainment
sections.body: Use the venue notes and favourites to record places you visit. Check the official ship guide and daily programme for current venues, opening times and reservations.

sections.heading: Your cruise plans
sections.body: Use My Cruise, packing, spending, favourites and port notes to organise your holiday.

sections.heading: Before travelling
sections.body: Check MSC Cruises booking details, passport and visa requirements, insurance, transfers and embarkation instructions.

sections.heading: Offline and privacy
sections.body: Personal notes are stored locally on this device. Official external links need internet access.

sections.heading: Disclaimer
sections.body: Independent unofficial guide, not endorsed by or affiliated with MSC Cruises. Confirm current information onboard.
